none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Strict feasibility in a bilinear parameterization: writing θ=(W,v), each sample must satisfy vᵀWqᵢ>0. These constraints are nonconvex jointly in W and v; no scalar optimization objective is specified.

problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Finite-data linear separation represented by a two-layer linear model of width dimension+1, with a prescribed cyclic, mistake-triggered update family.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: A query selects one sample index and parameter θ and returns its exact margin derivative, represented by direction using Euclidean and Frobenius coordinates. Replies have no noise or history dependence.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: The same query returns the exact scalar margin of the selected sample. Every query counts, including those with positive margin that cause no parameter update.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Features lie in ℝᵈ with Euclidean geometry; W is an unrestricted (d+1)×(d+1) linear map and v∈ℝᵈ⁺¹.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details:
Public parameters are d, n=count>0, κ, μ, ν, with 0<κ≤1, 0<μ≤κ⁴/2²⁰, and 0≤ν≤κ¹²μ²/2⁵⁶. Hidden residuals rᵢ and offsets δᵢ satisfy ‖rᵢ‖≤1, 0≤δᵢ≤ν, and ⟨w,rᵢ⟩≥κ for some hidden unit w. Signed samples are q₀=(1,0) and qᵢ₊₁=(-(1+δᵢ),-μrᵢ). Offsets are fixed data, not oracle errors.
Initialization is W=I and v=0. A fixed positive step size updates both layers using the returned direction exactly when the margin is nonpositive. Queries cycle through all n+1 samples, starting at index zero.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The final output must have strictly positive margin on every sample. There is no epsilon tolerance or required positive margin magnitude. The supplied fixed budget is (n+1)⌈256/κ⁴⌉ oracle calls.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CyclicFullWidthPerceptron.lean: Separates, spec.successful, family; supplied extracted budget for OracleTemplate.CyclicFullWidthPerceptronAcceleration.result.

accuracy.label: deterministic
accuracy.details: Separation is required for every outcome ω, including every algorithm and oracle seed, rather than only in expectation or almost surely.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines specially scaled, nearly opposing samples and tightly bounded offsets with a prescribed bilinear initialization and cyclic mistake-triggered updates. These restrictions define a specialized separation problem.
